rules.title: Local zoning, variances, and land-use procedure
rules.issue_question: Identify the operative zoning text, decision-maker, record, review standard, notice, and available appeal route for this land-use decision.
elements_to_verify: Identify the parcel, zoning district, requested use, and code version in effect on the decision date.
Verify the decision-maker's delegated authority, required findings, notice, hearing, and voting procedure.
Determine finality, standing, exhaustion, record scope, appeal deadline, and available remedy.
evidence_to_collect: Current and historical zoning text, application, staff report, notice, minutes, exhibits, and written findings.
Parcel maps, neighboring uses, service/impact evidence, communications, and administrative appeal filings.
opposing_questions: Does the code commit the decision to discretion and support the findings in the record?
Was the challenger timely, properly before the tribunal, and prejudiced by any procedural defect?
research_queries: Retrieve the adopted local code and amendment history from official enactment records.
Find controlling state decisions on the specific variance criteria, review standard, and deadline.
